description: For positive n, the minimum colouring of n-element subsets has no finite homogeneous subset with more than n elements.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PartitionRelations.minimumColoring_no_large_homogeneous (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (H : Finset ℕ)
  (hH : n < H.card) :
  ¬Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PartitionRelations.IsHomogeneous (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PartitionRelations.minimumColoring n hn)
      ↑H
